answer_raw:
The newest lineup is the **iPhone Duo** (as of Oct 2026) [1].

I didn't find the specific retail prices for the iPhone Duo, so you would need to check the Apple Store for the exact cost [1].

Upgrading from an iPhone 14 to the newest model is a **significant leap** that is likely worth it if you want modern features. Moving from the 14 to the 18 Pro offers improvements across the display, every camera, battery life, charging, connectivity, and sustained performance [4]. 

If you are using an iPhone 14 Pro, the **iPhone 18 Pro** is considered a worthwhile upgrade [4]. For standard iPhone 14 users, the jump will be even more noticeable due to the four generations of hardware changes [4]. Since the iPhone 14 is already seeing aging batteries and may struggle with newer iOS features, the hardware delta between your current phone and the newest flagship is substantial [7].
